notes.title: New update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Get ready for an exciting update! [/h1]
Here is the list of the changes:
[olist]
[*] Added sleeping💤
[*] Added cooking👩‍🍳
[*] Added a fireplace🪵
[*] Added a hammock🛏️
[*] Added a new tool (hammer, for building objects)🔨
[*] Added an animal🐄
[*] Added health bar and hunger bar❤️
[/olist]

And here is the TO-DO list:
[olist]
[*] Ability to explore islands for new resources🏝️
[*] Harbor building (transporting items)⚓️
[*] War system between colonies⚔️
[/olist]

When we finish this TO-DO list, there will be a demo of the game on our DISCORD. Hope it will be really soon!🫡

Check out the video to see all the new features in action!

You can chat with us here: https://discord.com/invite/BkSVRNQdDC

And don't forget to wishlist the game!
